concepts.title: 波的叠加
concepts.summary: 在线性叠加模型中，应将同一点、同一时刻的带方向位移（函数值）逐项相加。合成峰值振幅通常不等于两峰值振幅之和，它还取决于相位关系；波池与降噪耳机是教材所举的例子。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 先在同一位置 $x$、同一时刻 $t$ 求各波相对平衡位置的带正负号位移，再计算 $y(x,t)=y_1(x,t)+y_2(x,t)$；之后从合成波求峰值振幅，不能把两峰值直接相加。例如，同频同相时两波峰同时出现，峰值振幅相加。

en.title: Wave interference
en.summary: In a linear superposition model, add the signed displacements (function values) of the waves at the same position and the same instant. The resultant peak amplitude generally does not equal the sum of the individual peak amplitudes; relative phase matters. Wave pools and noise-cancelling headphones are the textbook examples.

method.title: Method
method.body: At the same position $x$ and instant $t$, find each wave’s signed displacement from equilibrium, then calculate $y(x,t)=y_1(x,t)+y_2(x,t)$. Find the peak amplitude from the resultant wave rather than adding the individual peaks directly. Equal-frequency waves in phase have peak amplitudes that add.
